name: datavidence-financials
description: Normalized US-GAAP financial statements from SEC EDGAR, as MCP tools: point-in-time, with a source filing behind every value.
long_description: Income statement, balance sheet and cash flow for any SEC XBRL filer (~2009 to present), normalized to one US-GAAP schema. Pull figures as originally reported for any date (no look-ahead bias), see how a year's numbers were revised across later filings, and cite the SEC accession behind each value. Works out of the box with the no-signup sandbox key (sample data); set your RapidAPI key for live data.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Leave as sandbox_demo_key for a no-signup trial (sample data). For live SEC data, paste your RapidAPI key and set the two gateway fields below.

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Keep the default for the sandbox. For a RapidAPI key use https://datavidence-financials-api.p.rapidapi.com

api_key_header.title: API key header
api_key_header.description: Keep X-API-Key for the sandbox. For a RapidAPI key use X-RapidAPI-Key

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Normalized income statement, balance sheet and cash flow for one company and fiscal year, optionally as originally reported on a date, with provenance and ratios.

tools.name: get_financials_batch
tools.description: The same statements for up to 25 companies in one call.

tools.name: get_revisions
tools.description: How a fiscal year's figures changed across later filings, with the filing date and EDGAR link behind every value.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find a company's ticker and CIK by ticker or name.

tools.name: list_filings
tools.description: List a company's recent SEC filings.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Your API key's tier, monthly limit and calls used.
